title: GMax AT-21S Anthracite

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: The Gmax AT-21S Anthracite is purpose-built for adventure riders tackling varied weather and challenging backcountry trails, bridging highway aero efficiency with rugged off-road ventilation. Built around a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell weighing a featherweight 1335g, its multi-density EPS matrix is aerodynamically sculpted to isolate cabin noise to ~90 dB while dissipating kinetic impact forces across DOT, ECE 22.05 benchmarks. Inside, 3D laser-cut cheek pads tailor naturally to an Long Oval profile with dedicated eyewear relief channels, secured by track-proven Double D-Ring retention for confident all-day riding.

product_details.description: Adventure helmet with integrated sun shield and removable peak.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Designed for adventure riding with a slightly open visor and integrated sun shield; fits most head shapes but may feel tight on very large heads due to dual-sport shell design.

technical_analysis: Features Advanced multi-composite aerodynamic shell geometry engineered for optimal impact absorption and stability paired with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release. The interior utilizes Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Gmax GMax AT-21S Anthracite: combining Global Certified craftsmanship with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release and Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.
yoast_title: Gmax GMax AT-21S Anthracite: Specs, Real-World Review & Price Guide
yoast_metadesc: In-depth review of the Gmax GMax AT-21S Anthracite. Tested shell weight, ECE/DOT safety rating, noise dB quietness, and fitment guide for Long Oval heads.

introduction: Positioned in Gmax's Adventure / Dual Sport lineup, the GMax AT-21S Anthracite brings Global Premium engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for a Long Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE 22.05 track safety.
story:
The Gmax AT-21S Anthracite represents Gmax's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~90 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan Adventure / Dual Sport helmet tailored to a Long Oval head shape, the Gmax AT-21S Anthracite delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
